reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already has getScheduledAmount deciding the missing/number/range dispatch for a schedule's expected amount, but toExternal writes its own null/number/range logic inline instead of using or extending it.

duplication.why: The missing->0 / number->itself / range->value dispatch duplicates getScheduledAmount's structure; the range rule itself is new inline arithmetic rather than a shared definition.

placement.why: A domain rule (what a schedule is expected to post) is placed in the API mapping layer (api-models.ts) instead of shared/schedules.ts where the scheduled-amount logic lives.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and the create-handler signatures needed to exclude the new read-only field are touched.

maintainability.why: The API now has its own private definition of the expected amount that diverges from the app's getScheduledAmount, so the two will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: scheduleModel.toExternal in server/api-models.ts computes expectedAmount inline instead of going through getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: toExternal's nested ternary reshapes getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch with a different range rule.
